q: The process of undergoing a chemical change is called a _____.
e: The process of undergoing a chemical change is called a chemical reaction. Chemical reaction is the idea that completes this fact. Physical reaction would fill a different blank than chemical reaction.

q: A chemical equation describes the reactants, the products, the rearrangement of the atoms, and the _____ of the reactants and the products.
e: A chemical equation describes the reactants, the products, the rearrangement of the atoms, and the weight relationship of the reactants and the products. Weight relationship is the idea that completes this fact. Temperature relationship would fill a different blank than weight relationship.

q: In an equation in words, the names of the _____ are written on the left-hand side of the equation.
e: In an equation in words, the names of the reactants are written on the left-hand side of the equation. Reactants is the idea that completes this fact. Catalysts would fill a different blank than reactants.

q: A complete balanced chemical equation has to abide by the Law of Conservation of Mass, which states that the total mass of the reactant(s) is equal to the total mass of the _____.
e: A complete balanced chemical equation has to abide by the Law of Conservation of Mass, which states that the total mass of the reactant(s) is equal to the total mass of the product(s). Product(s) is the idea that completes this fact. Catalyst(s) would fill a different blank than product(s).

q: The abbreviation '(aq)' in a chemical equation indicates that the substance is _____.
e: The abbreviation '(aq)' in a chemical equation indicates that the substance is aqueous or in water solution. A solution is a homogeneous mixture of solute dissolved in solvent. A solid precipitate would fill a different blank than aqueous or in water solution.

q: The abbreviation '$\Delta$' in a chemical equation represents _____.
e: The abbreviation ' ' in a chemical equation represents heat. Heat is the idea that completes this fact. Pressure would fill a different blank than heat.

q: The symbol '$\downarrow$' in a chemical equation indicates the _____.
e: The symbol ' ' in a chemical equation indicates the formation of precipitate. Formation of precipitate is the idea that completes this fact. Gas evolved would fill a different blank than formation of precipitate.

q: The symbol '$\uparrow$' in a chemical equation indicates that a _____.
e: The symbol ' ' in a chemical equation indicates that a gas evolved. Gas evolved is the idea that completes this fact. Precipitate formed would fill a different blank than gas evolved.

q: An ionic equation is a simplified chemical equation that shows the reactions involving _____ in solution.
e: An ionic equation is a simplified chemical equation that shows the reactions involving ions in solution. Ions is the idea that completes this fact. Molecules would fill a different blank than ions.

q: Ions that have not taken part in the chemical reaction and remain in solution at the end are called _____.
e: Ions that have not taken part in the chemical reaction and remain in solution at the end are called spectator ions. Spectator ions is the idea that completes this fact. Active ions is among the listed items, so it is not the exception.

q: The substances that take part in the reaction are called _____.
e: The substances that take part in the reaction are called reactants. Reactants is the idea that completes this fact. Catalysts would fill a different blank than reactants.

q: The substances that are produced in the reaction are called _____.
e: The substances that are produced in the reaction are called products. Products is the idea that completes this fact. Spectator ions would fill a different blank than products.

q: The symbol '$\rightleftharpoons$' in a chemical equation indicates a _____.
e: The symbol ' ' in a chemical equation indicates a reversible reaction. Reversible reaction is the idea that completes this fact. Combustion reaction would fill a different blank than reversible reaction.
